_comment: Career numbers the game (src/game/career.gd) and the accounts server (server/src/career/report.ts) both enforce. first_season: the first season a career can report. reputation: the manager's reputation range. start_reputation: the range a new manager starts in (0.18 x club reputation, clamped). max_gain_per_season and max_titles_per_season bound a plausible season report on the server (a season gives about +2,100 at most: title, objective, every cup, a World Cup, monthly awards).
